Priya Kapoor: Heads-up: AtlasPay EBR planning thread. Need slide owners for onboarding status, renewal risks, enablement asks, and feedback capture. Dry-run Thu 2026-03-27 10:30am PT. Who's in?
Ethan Moore: I can do enablement asks + one-liner on training adoption. Will surface outstanding playbook items.
Laila Hassan: I'll take onboarding status. Will pull onboarding tracker and highlight 3 customers in "stuck" state.
Noah Green: Renewal risks for me. I'll build a slide with risk buckets (usage, exec engagement, SLOs) and proposed mitigations. Need ARR snapshot from finance. @Priya can you confirm?
Priya Kapoor: Finance numbers in drive: https://drive.redwood/finance/atlaspay_renewals.xlsx. Also pasted a short exec quote from last exec call: "We need clearer reliability SLAs before commit."
CS-Bot: Reminder: dry-run calendar invite created for 2026-03-27 10:30am PT. Join link included.
Ethan Moore: For enablement slide, adding two asks: (1) run two 1:1 enablement sessions for ops team, (2) add streaming responses demo to docs.
Laila Hassan: Onboarding bullets: - 6 accounts fully onboarded - 3 accounts stuck at model integration - blocking item: KV cache mismatch on customer side. Suggest pairing session.
Noah Green: Renewal risk slide plan: top row = risk level, middle = signal (drop in MAU, SLO breaches), bottom = mitigation & owner. Adding a timeline to show when we escalate to AE.
Priya Kapoor: Quick demo plan: 3-min happy path + 2-min failover. Noah or Ethan can trigger failover in staging. Failover command: `./infra/failover --env=staging --target=quant-2.7`
Ethan Moore: I can trigger failover in staging. Will join dry-run early to test.
Laila Hassan: Action items recap: - Laila: onboarding slide + stuck account notes - Noah: renewal risks + mitigation owners + timeline - Ethan: enablement asks + run failover in dry-run - Priya: opening exec talking points + paste finance link in slide
Priya Kapoor: Adding two exec talking points: "Committed to 99th-p latency improvements" and "Proposed canary policy to reduce blast radius".
Noah Green: FYI adding a small section on churn drivers and next-step offers (credits, focused SRE support).
Ethan Moore: Will also capture enablement metrics: % seats trained, number of playbook runs.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks team. If any blockers, flag here. We'll do a 15-min pre-dry-run sync at 10:15am PT. :white_check_mark:
